description.text: The complete supplied first frame opens the film exactly as given: a black sports car with a carbon fibre body rests on an empty showroom floor, held in the darkness so only the car's form reads against the surrounding shadow. Nothing else occupies the floor, and no element of the image shifts position. The shot holds on the still, shadowed car as the opening image settles.
A low ambient room hum fills the showroom.

The car's engine catches and it pulls forward out of the dark, rolling off its mark toward the viewer. Its nose breaks from the shadow into the light, the carbon fibre body sweeping across the empty showroom floor as the vehicle advances and the darkness falls away behind it.
The black sports car begins to roll forward, emerging from the darkness into the light.
The engine catches and tyres roll on the smooth floor.
